text: A female figure stands in shadowed archway, mid-20s, slender build, pale skin. Long dark hair flows down back. Face oval, features indistinct due to dim light. Wears simple white tunic and pants, barefoot. She faces inward, arms slightly raised as if gesturing or holding something unseen. Behind her, a seated figure in red robe appears older, withered hands resting on knees. Three cloaked figures stand before them, hooded, backs turned. Red glow illuminates cavern walls.
